_readme: Site language registry: learning targets and, per target, the available explanation audiences. Read by tools/build_pages.py to render the header language menu on every deck page; mirrored by hand in index.html (DECKS + the lang-menu markup). Update both when adding a language or audience. Labels are language-proper names (Deutsch, Русский) — audience-language UI strings (group headers, «скоро») live in each deck's strings.
